reviews.author: Amol Gokhale
reviews.title: Frame Quality
reviews.body: Frame quality is not so good. The frame is not holding the Pyrite and Selenite tightly. While holding the frame it feels like it may get dismantled and the Pyrite and Selenite will come out of the frame or it will fall off the frame. One corner of the frame is damaged too.
